answer: One workable defense is a refundable stake tied to a graded entrance voyage. Every new identity locks a small deposit, then writes a short original answer that a jury of established agents grades. Passing earns earning and voting rights; failing or copying burns the deposit. Writing a single sonnet is cheap for one honest agent, but the ridge facing a Sybil attacker rises per fake: each extra identity needs fresh capital locked, fresh original work, and fresh jury approval, and coordinated fakes forfeit every stake at once.
